AbilityDef.label: vent
AbilityDef.description:
Connect the hole. For half a minute, anything that strikes the part it is in does not land on your pawn - it arrives inside the volume instead, still travelling.

Which part the hole is in was decided when the gene did, and it is on the health tab. RimWorld picks where a blow lands by how much of the body each part covers, so this is a share of incoming fire, not a shield: most hits will still find somewhere else.

While it is connected your pawn can fold through it, put people through it, and post things into it.

AbilityDef.label: fold
AbilityDef.description:
Step through your own hole and out of the world.

The hole stays where your pawn was standing. It is a real thing on the map, it glows, and anyone can see it - and anything fired into it arrives in the room your pawn is now standing in, still travelling. Hiding in there is not the same as being safe.

Cast again from inside to come back. Your pawn arrives at the aperture, exactly where they left, along with whatever they are carrying - which is one item, or one downed person, and no more.

The aperture stays standing after they step out, and that is how they reach the volume from outside it. It also never stops being a shooting lane into their own storeroom. Folding in from somewhere else moves it; collapse is what closes it.

AbilityDef.label: swallow
AbilityDef.description:
Put someone into the volume. Anyone: a raider in your face, or a colonist bleeding out across the field.

They are not hurt by it and they are not healed by it. They are simply somewhere else, in a room with no doctor and no food except what your pawn posted there earlier.

Only what fits goes through. The hole is about the size of a hand, so a person barely makes it and anything bigger than a megaspider does not - a centipede stays exactly where it is.

Getting out is the difference between the two uses. Someone who went in downed can be picked up and carried out. Someone who walked in on their own feet cannot be picked up at all, and stays until something puts them off them.

AbilityDef.label: post
AbilityDef.description:
Push something through the hole.

This is how the volume stops being an empty room. Medicine, food, a minified bed, a lamp - anything your pawn can point at goes in and stays there until somebody carries it back out by hand.

Goes through the hole on their body while it is connected, or through a standing aperture from anywhere on the map.

A carrier who did this before the raid has somewhere to take a wounded colonist. One who did not has a hole to die in.

AbilityDef.label: collapse
AbilityDef.description:
End the volume.

Everything in it goes: what your pawn stored, what they built, whoever they put in there, and every round the hole has ever taken. A new fold opens a new empty room, and the old one is not anywhere to go back to.

Swallow something and then collapse and you have killed it, with no corpse and no roll. It costs your pawn their entire dimension to do it.
AbilityDef.confirmationDialogText: Everything inside the volume will be destroyed, including anything and anyone stored there. This cannot be undone.
